sentences.text: She alleges that the Applicant has recorded an obscene video of hers.
She further contends that on the basis of the said video, the Applicant has been blackmailing and harassing her for over 4 years, threatening to circulate the same on social media.
In addition to the above, the victim alleges that the Applicant also sent messages pertaining to their purported relationship to her husband, thereby spoiling her marital life.
6. Counsel for Applicant argues that the Applicant has been falsely implicated.
In fact, he submits that the Prosecutrix has been indulging in extortion.
He submits that the Applicant is a Commando with the National Security Guard, who came in contact with the Prosecutrix in March, 2020 through the social media platform 'Tik Tok'.
He states that both the Prosecutrix as well as the Applicant were aware of each other's marital status and that they were already married to other people, which are subsisting.
It is submitted, that nonetheless, after an initial friendship, both the prosecutrix and the Applicant initiated a consensual physical relationship with each other.

7. Counsel further argues that since the Applicant wanted to continue and mend his relationship with his wife, he tried to end the relationship between him and the Prosecutrix on multiple occasions, but it was the Prosecutrix who started threatening and intimidating him, stating that she would share his explicit photos with his family and file a false rape case to defame him.
To this effect, the Applicant also filed a complaint against the Prosecutrix, inter-alia for extortion, criminal intimidation, harassment, This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 10/07/2025 at 22:08:44 cyber-bullying, defamation and filing false charges.
Therefore, in light of the above, counsel for the Applicant seeks interim protection from arrest in the present FIR and states that he willing to join investigation and cooperate with the same.

8. On the other hand, counsel for Prosecutrix opposes the present application and submits that the case not only involves serious allegations of sexual abuse and extortion, but that the Applicant has,
in fact, been threatening and blackmailing the Prosecutrix.
9. The Court has considered the submissions of the parties.
There is no doubt that the present case involves serious allegations of rape under intoxication, taking obscene videos, intimidation and extortion against the Applicant.
However, the Applicant claims that all these allegations are false and in fact, he is the one who is being harassed by the Prosecutrix.
The investigation in the present case is at a nascent stage as the subject FIR was registered recently on 1st July, 2025.
10. That being said, on a prima facie evaluation of the documents placed on record, it appears that are elements of the present case being one of an extra-marital affair gone awry.
As per the Prosecutrix's own contentions, the Applicant has been allegedly threatening and blackmailing her for 4 years, however, she did not make any complaint against him before.

In fact, it is noted that the FIR was filed on 1st July, 2025, whereas the Applicant had submitted his compliant against the Prosecutrix on 13 th April, 2025 - more than 2 months before the filing of the FIR.
